TEL AVIV, Israel, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Innoviz Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ: INVZ) (the "Company", "we", or "Innoviz"), a leading supplier of high-performance, automotive-grade LiDAR sensor platforms for the automotive, security, defense, and industrial markets, today announced that it will effect a reverse share split of its ordinary shares, no par value (the "Ordinary Shares"), at a ratio of 1-for-20 (the "Reverse Share Split"), together with a proportionate reduction of its authorized share capital from 500,000,000 to 25,000,000 Ordinary Shares.

The Reverse Share Split is expected to become effective at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on Friday, December 4, 2026 (the "Effective Time"), and the Ordinary Shares are expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on The Nasdaq Stock Market ("Nasdaq") at market open on Monday, December 7, 2026. The Ordinary Shares will continue to trade under the symbol "INVZ." The new CUSIP number for the Ordinary Shares following the Reverse Share Split will be M5R635 124 (ISIN IL0012498957).

The Company's shareholders approved the Reverse Share Split at the annual general meeting held on September 16, 2026, authorizing a ratio of between 1-for-5 and 1-for-20 to be determined by the Company's board of directors. The Reverse Share Split is intended to increase the per share trading price of the Ordinary Shares so that the Company can regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on Nasdaq. There can be no assurance that the Reverse Share Split will have that effect.

Effect on Outstanding Shares

At the Effective Time, every twenty (20) Ordinary Shares issued and outstanding will automatically be combined into one (1) Ordinary Share. The number of outstanding Ordinary Shares will be reduced from approximately 299,546,196 (as of November 17, 2026) to approximately 14,977,309. The Reverse Share Split will affect all shareholders uniformly and will not change any shareholder's percentage ownership interest, except for the treatment of fractional shares described below.

Fractional Shares

No fractional Ordinary Shares will be issued in connection with the Reverse Share Split. Shareholders who would otherwise be entitled to a fractional share will instead receive a cash payment, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes, equal to such fraction multiplied by the closing price of the Ordinary Shares on Nasdaq on December 4, 2026, the trading day immediately preceding the Effective Time (as adjusted to give effect to the Reverse Share Split). Shareholders holding fewer than twenty (20) Ordinary Shares immediately before the Effective Time will receive only cash and will no longer hold Ordinary Shares.

Shareholder Action

Equiniti Trust Company, LLC, the Company's transfer agent, will act as exchange agent. Shareholders holding Ordinary Shares in book-entry form with the transfer agent do not need to take any action; their holdings will be adjusted automatically and any cash payment will be sent to them. Shareholders holding Ordinary Shares through a broker, bank or other nominee do not need to take any action; their accounts will be adjusted, and any cash payment credited, under the nominee's procedures, which may differ from those described above.

Equity Awards and Warrants

Proportionate adjustments will be made to the number of Ordinary Shares issuable under the Company's equity incentive plans and outstanding equity awards, and to the number of Ordinary Shares issuable upon exercise of, and the exercise price of, the Company's outstanding warrants, in each case in accordance with their terms.

Tax Considerations

For a summary of certain U.S. federal income tax and Israeli tax considerations of the Reverse Share Split, including the receipt of cash in lieu of fractional shares, see Exhibit 99.2 to the Company's Report on Form 6-K furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 18, 2026, together with the Company's proxy statement for the annual general meeting held on September 16, 2026. Shareholders are urged to consult their tax advisors with respect to the particular tax consequences of the Reverse Share Split.

About Innoviz
Innoviz is a leading provider of LiDAR technology, serving as a Tier-1 supplier to the world's leading automotive manufacturers while extending its existing sensing solutions into defense, homeland security, industrial, and smart infrastructure markets.

Innoviz's LiDAR sensors and complementary software suite are designed to deliver exceptional range, resolution, and reliability, providing accurate 3D sensing even in harsh weather conditions. Built to meet the automotive industry's strict standards for performance and safety, Innoviz's sensors are increasingly supplied for applications that demand precise, real-time spatial awareness and continuous object localization.

Operating across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, Innoviz designs solutions for automotive OEMs, system integrators, municipalities, commercial enterprises, government organizations, and other customers worldwide. Under the Perciz brand, Innoviz offers its existing automotive-grade LiDAR sensors for defense, counter-UAS, perimeter intrusion detection, and homeland security applications. THE WOODLANDS, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PPIH), a global leader in engineered piping and corrosion protection solutions, today announced $37 million in additional new orders during the third quarter ended October 31, 2026. Together with the approximate $28 million in new orders reported in the Company October 20, 2026 update, third quarter total new orders total approximately $65 million.

Most of the additional new orders came from the MENA region, where demand for specialized pipeline solutions is supported by ongoing investments in oil and gas infrastructure and major energy-related projects, with the balance from North America. The additional bookings follow the Company's October 20, 2026 announcement of approximately $28 million in third-quarter bookings and reflect continued commercial momentum across its Middle East and North Africa (MENA) and North American (NA) regions.

In particular, MENA continues to represent an important growth market for Perma-Pipe. The Company's established regional presence, technical expertise, manufacturing capabilities and long-standing relationships with major customers and contractors position it to capitalize on opportunities arising from the region's ongoing energy infrastructure development. The Company's North American operations also contributed to the additional bookings, reinforcing the benefits of its geographical diversification and continued focus on expanding its presence across key markets.

Strategic Expansion into India

In a further milestone in its international expansion strategy, Perma-Pipe, through its subsidiary Perma-Pipe Qatar, has completed the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in the newly formed Welspun Special Coating Private Limited (WSCPL) from Welspun DI Pipes Limited (WDI), a wholly owned subsidiary of Welspun Corp Limited. WDI retains the remaining 49% interest.

The joint venture will focus on internal fusion-bonded epoxy (IFBE) coating and related activities in India. This acquisition expands Perma-Pipe's specialized coating capabilities and provides a platform to pursue opportunities in India's domestic market and international export markets, serving the oil and gas, water and industrial infrastructure sectors.

Saleh Sagr, President and Chief Executive Officer of Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc., commented:

“Securing an additional $37 million in bookings during the third quarter, bringing our total quarterly bookings to approximately $65 million, reflects the strength of our commercial momentum, particularly in the MENA oil and gas market. Our continued activity in North America further demonstrates the benefits of our geographical diversification.

“We are equally pleased to have completed the acquisition of a 51% interest in Welspun Special Coating Private Limited through Perma-Pipe Qatar. This partnership combines Perma-Pipe's specialized coating expertise with Welspun's established industrial presence in India, expanding our capabilities and providing an important platform to pursue opportunities in India and international markets.

“Together, these achievements reflect our commitment to disciplined expansion, strengthening our competitive position and creating new avenues for sustainable, profitable growth and long-term shareholder value.”

About Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc.

Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PPIH) is a global leader in engineered piping and corrosion protection solutions. The Company provides pre-insulated piping systems, leak detection systems, anti-corrosion coatings and related engineered products and services to customers across the energy, district energy, infrastructure, industrial, Oil & Gas, water transmission, and other critical infrastructure markets.

Perma-Pipe operates manufacturing and service facilities across North America, Middle East, North Africa, India and other strategic markets, enabling the Company to serve customers globally while providing local manufacturing and engineering capabilities.

TOKYO, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- MEDIROM Healthcare Technologies Inc. (Nasdaq: MRM) (the “Company”) today announced that on November 13, 2026, it received a notice (the “Notice”) from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) because the Company had not filed its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025 (the “Annual Report”) within the extension period previously granted by Nasdaq and therefore had not regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1).

As previously disclosed, Nasdaq notified the Company on May 26, 2026, that it was not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) because it had not timely filed the Annual Report. Nasdaq subsequently granted the Company an extension to regain compliance. The Company did not file the Annual Report within that extension period. The Notice stated that unless the Company requests an appeal of the delisting determination, trading of the Company’s American Depositary Shares will be subject to suspension and delisting from Nasdaq at the opening of business on November 24, 2026.

On November 18, 2026, the Company timely submitted a request for a hearing before a Nasdaq Hearings Panel (the “Panel”) to appeal the determination. Under the applicable Nasdaq rules, the hearing request automatically stays any suspension of trading in the Company’s American Depositary Shares (“ADSs”) for 15 days from the date of the request. The Notice also stated that when the Company requests a hearing, it may also request a stay of the suspension pending the hearing. The Company has requested an extended stay of any trading suspension pending completion of the hearing process.

The Company filed the Annual Report with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 18, 2026. The Company has presented the filing of the Annual Report to Nasdaq in support of its appeal and request for continued listing. There can be no assurance that Nasdaq will determine that the filing resolves the Company’s periodic reporting deficiency or results in the cancelation of a hearing, that the Panel will grant any further stay of suspension or the Company’s request for continued listing, or that the Company will regain or maintain compliance with all applicable Nasdaq continued listing requirements.

The Notice relates to the Company’s periodic reporting deficiency. Separately, as previously disclosed, on October 6, 2026, the Company received a notice that it was not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Nasdaq provided the Company until April 5, 2027, to regain compliance with that requirement. Filing the Annual Report does not resolve this separate minimum bid price deficiency.

WILMINGTON, Del., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Chemours Company ("Chemours" or "the Company") (NYSE: CC), a global chemistry company with leading market positions in Thermal & Specialized Solutions ("TSS"), Titanium Technologies ("TT"), and Advanced Performance Materials ("APM"), today announced that Kristine Wellman, Senior Vice President, General Counsel & Corporate Secretary, will retire from Chemours. Concurrent with this change, effective January 4, 2027, Amy Rocklin will join Chemours to serve as Senior Vice President, General Counsel & Corporate Secretary. As part of her transition, effective January 4, 2027, Wellman will move into the role of SVP, Senior Counsel to President and Chief Executive Officer Denise Dignam, where she will continue to provide counsel and support to the Company until May 2027.

Wellman joined Chemours in 2014 and has made significant contributions to the Company through a diverse range of leadership roles spanning legal, strategic planning, sustainability and manufacturing operations. She was part of the legal leadership team that helped stand up Chemours as an independent public company and today leads a global team of legal, corporate governance, enterprise risk, compliance, security, sustainability and government affairs professionals.

"Kristine has been an extraordinary leader, colleague and trusted advisor, and her impact on Chemours extends well beyond the legal function," said Denise Dignam, President and Chief Executive Officer of Chemours. "Her breadth of experience, sound judgment and unwavering commitment to integrity have helped shape our company from its earliest days. I am deeply grateful for Kristine's partnership and many contributions to Chemours, and I am pleased that we will continue to benefit from her experience and counsel during this transition."

Rocklin joins Chemours with more than two decades of legal, business and scientific experience in complex, technology-driven industries. Most recently, she served as Chief Legal & Administrative Officer and Corporate Secretary at Neogen Corporation, where she led global Legal and Compliance and enterprise risk, advised the Board of Directors, and held leadership responsibility for regulatory affairs, quality, government and industry affairs, and sustainability. Prior to Neogen, Rocklin spent nearly 10 years at Corning Incorporated, ultimately serving as Vice President, Corporate Law. She holds a Juris Doctor from The George Washington University Law School and a Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Biophysics from the University of Minnesota.

"Amy brings a powerful combination of legal expertise, business acumen and scientific and technical understanding to Chemours," said Dignam. "She has spent her career working at the intersection of law, science, technology and business and understands what it takes to lead in highly regulated global industries. Her experience advising boards and executive teams and navigating complex business and regulatory matters will make her a strong addition to our leadership team. We are excited to welcome Amy and look forward to her leadership and contributions as we execute our Pathway to Thrive strategy and position Chemours for long-term success."

About The Chemours Company
The Chemours Company (NYSE: CC) is a global leader in providing industrial and specialty chemicals products for markets, including coatings, plastics, refrigeration and air conditioning, transportation, semiconductor and advanced electronics, general industrial, and oil and gas. Through our three businesses – Thermal & Specialized Solutions, Titanium Technologies, and Advanced Performance Materials – we deliver application expertise and chemistry-based innovations that solve customers' biggest challenges. Our flagship products are sold under prominent brands such as Opteon™, Freon™, Ti-Pure™, Nafion™, Teflon™, Viton™, and Krytox™. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware and listed on the NYSE under the symbol CC, Chemours has approximately 5,700 employees and 28 manufacturing sites and serves approximately 2,400 customers in approximately 110 countries. Revenue increased by $0.5 million, or 19%, compared to the same period last year. The upgrade has a total estimated capital cost of approximately $1.4 million, to be funded by a combination of proceeds from this FCC facility increase and operating cash flow. EverGen anticipates partially offsetting these costs by applying for rebates under FortisBC’s Custom Efficiency Program once the upgrade is complete and the actual energy savings are confirmed. The new unit is targeted to be operational by mid-2027. With FVB and GrowTEC continuing to set new RNG production records, the upgrade is expected to further improve efficiency at FVB and support stronger cash flow from EverGen’s core operating assets.

(NYSE: CPA), today announced financial results for the third quarter (3Q26), which reflect the resilience of the Company's business model and disciplined execution amid a significantly higher jet fuel price environment. Key highlights include:

  • Net profit of US$175.8 million or US$4.29 per share, a 2.2% year‑over‑year increase in earnings per share.
  • Operating margin of 18.6% and net margin of 14.6%, a decrease of 4.6 and 4.4 percentage points, respectively, compared to 3Q25.

  • Operating revenue increased 31.9% year over year, and revenue per available seat mile (RASM) increased 13.5% compared to 3Q25.
  • Operating cost per available seat mile excluding fuel (Ex-Fuel CASM) increased 1.1% year over year to 5.7 cents.
  • The Company ended the quarter with approximately US$1.6 billion in cash, short-term and long-term investments, which represent 38% of the last twelve months’ revenues.
  • The Company closed 3Q26 with a Net Debt to EBITDA ratio of 0.8 times.
  • In September, Copa Airlines was recognized by Skytrax for the eleventh consecutive year as the “Best Airline in Central America and the Caribbean.”
  • Copa Airlines had an on-time performance for the quarter of 87.1% and a flight completion factor of 99.7%, once again positioning itself among the best in the industry.

Subsequent events

  • On November 18, 2026, the Board of Directors of Copa Holdings ratified its fourth dividend payment for the year of US$1.71 per share. Dividends will be paid on December 15, 2026, to shareholders on record as of November 30, 2026.

RICHMOND, Va., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Markel Group Inc. (NYSE: MKL) announced today that its Board of Directors approved a $2.5 billion increase to the Company's existing share repurchase authorization.

The Company may repurchase shares from time to time in open-market or privately negotiated transactions, including under plans adopted pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 and, for open-market purchases, in accordance with Rule 10b-18, under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The program has no expiration date and may be terminated by the Board at any time.

Markel Group Inc. (NYSE: MKL) is a diverse family of companies that includes everything from insurance to bakery equipment, building supplies, houseplants, and more. SAN DIEGO, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Beam Global, (Nasdaq: BEEM), (the “Company”), a leading provider of innovative and sustainable infrastructure solutions for energy storage and security, electrification of transportation, and smart city infrastructure, today announced its third quarter operating results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Q3 2026 and Recent Company Highlights:

Financial:

  • Revenues increase 15% YoY to $6.7M
  • Gross margins increase to 21% GAAP, 32% adjusted net of non-cash items
  • Gross profit of $1.4M GAAP, $2.1M cash adjusted net of non-cash
  • 67% increase in cash over December 31, 2025
  • $6.9M backlog as of September 30, 2026, up 28% from $5.4M at June 30, 2026
  • Relocated manufacturing from San Diego, CA to Yuma, AZ resulting in almost $3M in savings across lease term

Operational:

  • Record quarter for Beam Europe smart city infrastructure sales: approximately $4 million in Q3 orders across Serbia, Montenegro, Croatia, Romania, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Greece, including smart city infrastructure for Lidl in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
  • Received more than $500,000 in specialized battery orders from recurring customers in the drone and autonomous robotics markets within a single week, demonstrating continued commercial demand for Beam's advanced and bespoke battery technology.
  • Continued leveraging Federal GSA procurement channels through repeat government customer orders, including the City of Dallas (10 additional EV ARC™ systems), Dry Creek Rancheria Band of Pomo Indians (five EV ARC™ systems and an ARC Mobility™ Trailer), and the City of Long Beach (six additional EV ARC™ systems).
  • Expanded recurring-revenue EV ARC™ deployments through new commercial and community mobility initiatives, including a sponsorship-funded deployment at Aqua Park Raj in Serbia and four Greater Boston locations supporting the CommunityEV carsharing pilot.
  • Relocated California manufacturing operations to a new 55,000-square-foot facility in Yuma, Arizona, expected to generate approximately $3 million in rent savings over the five-year lease term, alongside additional anticipated operating cost reductions.
  • Beam Middle East signed an MOU with Masdar City Free Zone in Abu Dhabi to explore off-grid EV charging, solar-integrated e-bike solutions and other sustainable energy infrastructure opportunities.
  • Advanced opportunities in Ukraine to support energy security and infrastructure reconstruction, positioning Beam's rapidly deployable off-grid power generation, energy storage, EV charging and humanitarian heating solutions for reconstruction projects.
  • Introduced brand-new patent pending BeamHeat™ product in Ukraine - a Beam battery powered device providing heating, cooking, lighting and recharging of portable devices, to people in environments where grid interruptions deny them access to basic comforts.
  • Presented advanced battery technology for AI data centers, with Beam's high-pulse-power battery design at IECON 2026 in Doha, Qatar.
  • Strengthened Beam's intellectual property portfolio with a European patent for Smart Phase Change Composite (PCC™) passive battery thermal management technology, supporting applications across e-mobility, energy storage, robotics and defense.
  • Expanded international engagement and industry presence through participation in major industry events and conferences, including The Battery Show North America, IECON 2026, SESA Summit Puerto Rico, PWX, and European e-mobility and smart infrastructure events in Serbia and Croatia.
  • Received the GovTech Breakthrough Award for "Connected Infrastructure Solution of the Year" for the EV ARC™, recognizing Beam's contribution to connected and resilient infrastructure.
  • Developed and launched a completely redesigned corporate website, strengthening Beam Global's digital presence, improving the presentation of its product portfolio and supporting engagement with investors.

“Our third quarter results reflect the strength of the diversified business we have built creating, manufacturing, and selling products into the most relevant and current opportunities in the world today – energy generation and storage, innovation in mobility and autonomy and intelligence in built infrastructure,” said Desmond Wheatley, CEO of Beam Global. “Revenues grew 15% year-over-year and our gross margin improved to approximately 32% excluding non-cash items. Commercial customers accounted for 92% of our revenues in the quarter, and more than half of our sales came from outside the United States. Beam Europe delivered a record quarter for smart city infrastructure orders, and our backlog grew 28% from the end of the second quarter to $6.9 million. We continue to see increasing demand for our bespoke battery technology from defense, drone, mobility and autonomous robotics customers, and our battery team is developing solutions that we believe will be vital to the power requirements of AI data centers. We strengthened our IP portfolio with new patents in the U.S. and Europe. Though the situation in the Middle East remains challenging, we are advancing new prospects there and continue to believe that potentially very large opportunities can develop for us in the region. Our European facilities in Serbia are well positioned to play an outsized role in Ukraine’s reconstruction with our energy, communications and transportation products. I have received unanimous interest in our brand-new BeamHeat product during my current visit to Ukraine where it can provide essential comforts like heat, light and warm food to the population during a long winter of grid interruptions. We have matched our growth in revenues and gross margins with successful efforts to reduce costs while improving our operational capabilities in the U.S. Most notably in the 3rd quarter we completed the move of our manufacturing operations to Yuma, Arizona, which we expect to save approximately $3 million in rent over the lease term. I applaud the Beam team for their execution, and I believe we are well positioned to convert our growing pipeline into revenue in the coming quarters and to take advantage of all the new opportunities which we have developed across multiple segments internationally and in the U.S.”

Q3 2026 Financial Summary

Revenues

Revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $6.7 million, an increase of $0.9 million, or 15%, over $5.8 million in the third quarter of 2025. Non-government commercial customers represented 92% of revenues and state and local government customers 6%, compared to 82% and 18%, respectively, a year earlier. Sales outside the United States were 56% of revenues in the quarter and 51% for the first nine months of 2026, up from 43% and 39%, respectively, a year earlier, led by Serbia, where revenues nearly doubled to $2.1 million, and Romania, where revenues increased to $0.9 million from $0.3 million. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, revenues were $18.4 million compared to $19.2 million a year earlier, a decrease the Company believes is primarily a function of order timing rather than a change in underlying demand. Backlog was $6.9 million as of September 30, 2026, an increase of $1.5 million, or 28%, from $5.4 million as of June 30, 2026.

Gross Profit

The Company reported gross profit of $1.4 million, a gross margin of 21.3%, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to a gross loss of $28 thousand, or (0.5%), in the third quarter of 2025, and a gross margin of 17.8% in the second quarter of 2026. Non-cash charges in cost of revenues, consisting of depreciation and amortization of intangible assets from the All-Cell acquisition, were $0.7 million in the third quarter of 2026 and $0.8 million a year earlier. Excluding these items, adjusted Non-GAAP gross profit was $2.1 million, an adjusted Non-GAAP gross margin of 31.9% in the quarter, compared to 12.8% a year earlier. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, gross margin was 13.8%, compared to 9.9% a year earlier, and adjusted Non-GAAP gross margin was 25.4%, compared to 21.5% a year earlier.

The Company believes its margins will continue to improve as revenues grow and fixed overhead absorption increases, and as ongoing cost reduction initiatives, including the relocation of its manufacturing operations to Yuma, Arizona, continue to take effect.

Operating Expenses

Operating expenses were $5.9 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $4.8 million a year earlier. The $1.1 million increase was primarily driven by a $0.4 million increase in non-cash stock-based compensation, a $0.4 million increase in legal expenses, and $0.3 million of costs associated with the relocation of the Company’s facilities. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, operating expenses were $16.7 million compared to $26.8 million a year earlier, which included a $10.8 million non-cash goodwill impairment charge. Nine-month 2026 expenses included a $1.6 million non-cash provision for credit losses, primarily relating to a single customer balance reserved in accordance with Company policy. Excluding non-cash items, including the goodwill impairment and provisions for credit losses, Non-GAAP operating expenses for the first nine months of 2026 were $12.7 million, an increase of $0.2 million, or 1%, compared to $12.5 million in the prior year period.

Net Loss

The Company reported a net loss of $4.5 million, or $(0.20) per share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $4.9 million, or $(0.28) per share, a year earlier. The quarter’s net loss includes $2.0 million in non-cash charges, consisting primarily of $1.1 million of stock-based compensation and $0.8 million of depreciation and amortization. Excluding these items, Non-GAAP net loss was $2.5 million, or $(0.11) per share, compared to $2.8 million, or $(0.16) per share, a year earlier. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company reported a net loss of $14.4 million, or $(0.66) per share, compared to $24.7 million, or $(1.54) per share, a year earlier, which included the $10.8 million goodwill impairment charge. The nine months ended September 30, 2026 net loss includes $6.2 million of non-cash items. Excluding these items, Non-GAAP net loss was $8.2 million in both periods, while Non-GAAP net loss per share improved to $(0.38) from $(0.51) a year earlier.

Management believes the year-over-year revenue growth, the improvement in both GAAP and Non-GAAP gross margins, and the growth in backlog reflect the Company’s expanded opportunities created through geographic and product portfolio expansion, the increasing contribution of its European operations, and continued cost reduction initiatives. Given its disciplined cost structure and the largely fixed nature of its non-cash charges, the Company believes it has meaningful operating leverage as revenue increases.

Non-GAAP Financial Measures

To supplement our condensed consolidated financial statements prepared in accordance with GAAP, Beam Global presents certain Non-GAAP measures in this press release, including Non-GAAP Gross Profit, Non-GAAP Gross Margin, Non-GAAP Total Operating Expenses, Non-GAAP Net Loss and Non-GAAP Net Loss per share. These measures exclude non-cash items including provisions for credit losses, stock-based compensation, depreciation and amortization, warrant amortization, changes in the fair value of contingent consideration, and impairment of goodwill. We use Non-GAAP measures in conjunction with GAAP measures as part of our overall assessment of our performance to evaluate the effectiveness of our business strategies and to communicate with our board of directors concerning our financial performance. We believe Non-GAAP measures are also helpful to investors, analysts and other interested parties because they can assist in providing a more consistent and comparable overview of our operations across our historical financial periods. These Non-GAAP measures have limitations as analytical tools. Therefore, you should not consider them in isolation or as a substitute for analysis of our results as reported under GAAP. Because of these limitations, you should consider these Non-GAAP measures alongside other financial performance measures, including Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, Net Loss and other GAAP measures. In evaluating these Non-GAAP measures you should be aware that in the future we may incur expenses that are the same as, or similar to, some of the adjustments reflected in this press release. Our presentation of these Non-GAAP measures should not be construed to imply that our future results will be unaffected by the types of items excluded from the calculations of these Non-GAAP measures. These Non-GAAP measures are not presented in accordance with GAAP and the use of these terms varies from others in our industry. Reconciliations of these Non-GAAP measures to the most directly comparable GAAP measures have been provided in the financial statement tables included within this press release, and investors are encouraged to review these reconciliations.

PURCHASE, N.Y., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Board of Directors of PepsiCo, Inc. (NASDAQ: PEP) today declared a quarterly dividend of $1.48 per share of PepsiCo common stock, a 4 percent increase versus the comparable year-earlier period. Today's action is consistent with PepsiCo's previously announced increase in its annualized dividend to $5.92 per share from $5.69 per share, which began with the June 2026 payment. This dividend is payable on January 6, 2027 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 4, 2026. PepsiCo has paid consecutive quarterly cash dividends since 1965, and 2026 marked the company's 54th consecutive annual dividend increase. 

About PepsiCo
PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world. PepsiCo generated nearly $94 billion in net revenue in 2025, driven by a complementary beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker, and SodaStream. PepsiCo's product portfolio includes a wide range of enjoyable foods and beverages, including many iconic brands that generate more than $1 billion each in estimated annual retail sales.

Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to Be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with pep+ (PepsiCo Positive). pep+ is our strategic end-to-end transformation that puts sustainability and human capital at the center of how we will create value and growth by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for planet and people.
